gloss: to hurt, to injure, to damage

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {傷|きず}つけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to hurt, to injure, to wound, to damage

⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つけ→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧た。

notes:
{傷|きず}つける means to hurt, injure, or wound—either physically or emotionally.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {傷|きず}つける (transitive): to hurt, wound
- ⟦{傷|きず}つく→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧ (intransitive): to get hurt, be wounded

CONJUGATION (ichidan):
- ⟦{傷|きず}つけない→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧ (negative)
- ⟦{傷|きず}つけ→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧ます (polite)
- ⟦{傷|きず}つけ→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧た (past)
- ⟦{傷|きず}つけ→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧て (te-form)
- ⟦{傷|きず}つけ→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧られる (passive: to be hurt)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傷|きず}つける: to hurt someone
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傷|きず}つける: to hurt someone's feelings
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傷|きず}つける: to injure one's body
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傷|きず}つける: to scratch a car
- {傷|きず}つける⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧: I didn't mean to hurt you

FORMS:
⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧ (wound) + ⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (attach/cause) = to cause a wound

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧: wound, injury, scratch
- ⟦{傷|きず}つき→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧⟦やすい→易い：00464_yasui⟧: easily hurt, sensitive
- ⟦{怪我|けが}→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to injure (cause injury)
